findings.title: Exit-code contract is changed and code 4 is reused for a different meaning
findings.body: The update-compatibility documentation tells users to rely on the command exit code, but this change moves the recreate-required result from exit code 4 to 3 and assigns exit code 4 to 'feature disabled'. Any script or pipeline written against the previous behavior may misinterpret the result, for example treating feature-disabled as recreate-required or failing to recognize the new recreate code. If this exit-code contract has already been exposed, consider keeping 4 for recreate and using a new unused code for feature disabled, or explicitly handle this as a breaking change.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test does not verify the documented exit code
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error message. The PR introduces and documents exit code 4 for the case where the rolling-updates feature is disabled, but the test does not assert that the CLI exits with 4. Without this assertion, regressions in the documented exit-code contract can go unnoticed.

findings.title: Incompatible-version tests do not verify the recreate exit code
findings.body: testWrongVersions asserts only the error message after running update-compatibility check with mismatched Keycloak or Infinispan versions. Since the PR changes the recreate-required exit code to 3 and documents that value, the test should also assert that the command returns exit code 3 in these incompatibility cases.

findings.title: Test setup overwrites existing enabled features
findings.body: createInitialDeployment calls setEnabledFeatures(List.of(Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES.getKey())), replacing any features that may already be present in the FeatureSpec. If the base Keycloak deployment used by the test enables other features, they will be silently disabled for these tests. The code should preserve existing enabled features and append rolling-updates, and preferably use a mutable list if the CR model may later be modified.

findings.title: Documentation overstates or ambiguously states the rolling-updates feature requirement
findings.body: The caution says that while the functionality is preview, the rolling-updates feature must be enabled or the Keycloak Operator will fail. However, the same section describes a default/unset update strategy, and the UpgradeTest only enables rolling-updates when an explicit update strategy is set. The documentation should clarify whether the feature is required only when spec.update is used, or the operator/test behavior should be aligned with the stated requirement.
